results.comment: 25:50 - I'm so sick of everyone misreading Hume's "reason is, and ought only to be, the slave of the passions" quote. He's saying reason can help you get your passions (desire), but it can't help you decide what your desires should be. E.g. if you want ice cream, reason can help you locate the closest ice cream shop but it can't tell you to want a salad instead.
